blocks.body: Price Heroku against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.body: Budget risk: Does not outrank Render (7.9) as the cloud-paas award. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Eco list price dynos sleep after 30 minutes of inactivity and are personal-only — not always-on production; Basic list price is the always-on floor

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Not managed WordPress hosting (WP Engine) — landscape only

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not ITSM, observability, a git host, or a panel licence
